description.text: Pop-up shop park and retail incubator in Downtown Guthrie, Oklahoma.

targetApplicants.text: Nestled in the heart of Downtown Guthrie, The Shoppes is a lively retail hub that celebrates local creativity and community spirit. Designed to showcase local talent and entrepreneurial spirit, The Shoppes serves as a retail incubator that provides small businesses and start-ups with an affordable, low-risk space to grow and thrive. Blending commerce with community, this lively destination invites visitors to shop for unique local goods, enjoy delicious food, and relax in an inviting outdoor atmosphere that reflects Guthrie’s welcoming charm. Whether you’re exploring for the first time or returning to your favorite vendor, The Shoppes offers an authentic Guthrie experience, where creativity, community, and commerce meet.
